meets: Three fixed moments of a world 1 bot run stalled for 70 to 100 ms in the wave 36 red team, and the same run stalls on wave 35. The cause was found on 11 Nov: a headless bot run has no sound device, so the game's worker-thread audio warm-ups are off, and two radio lines and one music pad render on the main thread the first time they are asked for (audio.gd live_output, music_engine.gd _warm_stinger). With the played game's warm-up on (the bot flag --warm-band=1) all three stalls are gone and the run replays the same, so a player should not meet them. Two things still need MangoHud or a PC film: the tick on which the dam Warden breaks runs 35 to 38 ms on a loaded PC, and a radio line could wait on the audio worker if the worker is busy when the line is due (not measured). The red team's hitch replays get the warm-up flag in wave 37. 12 Nov re-read on the park maps (cand/w38, --table=park --warm-band=1): the three stalls stay gone and the run wins all six stages. Each Warden engage then costs one multi-second tick, but that is the bot's own build: a bot run builds the next park stage whole on the main thread so a seed replays (terrain.gd _worker_builds, world.gd _prepare_after, 4.57 s); with --threaded-stages=1, as the played game builds, the worst tick after the first is 79 ms. Hitch replays need --threaded-stages=1 as well as --warm-band=1
